# Doctor Ragimoff — ragimoff.org

> Kənan Rəhimov (Kenan Ragimov, Кенан Рагимов) — psychiatrist and psychotherapist in Baku, Azerbaijan; school of psychology, consultations, training programs and books. Site languages: Azerbaijani (main), Russian, English. Every page exists at /az/, /ru/ and /en/.

## Notes

- Freud's works are translated into Azerbaijani by the school (first complete Azerbaijani edition); other languages of Freud are not published here.
- Contact: https://ragimoff.org/en/contact.html
